subject: Urgent: LumenBridge throughput spike and proposed commercial path
messages:
From: Emily Wu <emily.wu@lumenbridge.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: contracts@lumenbridge.com, support@lumenbridge.com
Date: 2028-06-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production impact Jun 25-27 — throughput + 5xx

Hi Karthik,

We experienced a sustained throughput drop and elevated 5xx rate on Jun 25-27 that materially impacted our user-facing inference pipelines. Latency for median requests jumped from ~120ms to ~720ms during the peak window and our tail latencies spiked well above the SLO. This caused downstream throttling and a missed nightly data processing window.

We need two things quickly:
- A commercial remediation (credit/refund) for the service degradation days and a clear calculation model.
- Confirmation of what changes you made / will make to prevent recurrence and a short-term monitoring plan.

I've attached a short set of sample logs and our request traces (incident-sample-logs.txt). Our legal and contracts teams are CC'd — they want an initial commercial position by EOD Monday so we can start our internal approval.

Emily Wu
Head of Platform Engineering
LumenBridge
emily.wu@lumenbridge.com

--- attachment: incident-sample-logs.txt (text)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Wu <emily.wu@lumenbridge.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai, contracts@lumenbridge.com
Date: 2028-06-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production impact Jun 25-27 — throughput + 5xx

Emily — thanks for the clear summary and the logs. I'm very sorry for the disruption. We're treating this as a priority incident and have already pulled the full token-level and scheduling traces.

Quick notes:
- Preliminary root cause looks like an interaction between a workload burst on a small subset of model pools and our dynamic autoscaling thresholds that caused transient queuing and degraded KV-cache hit behavior.
- We've applied a safety patch to routing and temporarily pinned affected pools to higher concurrency while we rerun kernel-selection heuristics.
- We're assembling a short technical post-mortem and a throughput analysis (attached: throughput-analysis-20280628.csv).

For commercial remediation, can you confirm the billing window you want us to evaluate? Our finance and legal teams normally calculate credits on actual affected token counts + SLA scale factor; I'll propose a preliminary credit and a draft amendment for signature after internal alignment.

I can be on an exec call tomorrow at 10am PT if that works for your team.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
--- attachment: throughput-analysis-20280628.csv (CSV)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-28T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: internal — LumenBridge commercial posture

Karthik / Naomi —

Quick read of the CSV: peak affected period is 2028-06-25T22:30:00Z to 2028-06-27T05:15:00Z; token throughput fell ~42% for affected routes, and 5xx rate averaged ~6.8% vs baseline 0.1%.

Proposed commercial posture: offer a defined monetary credit equal to 25% of invoiced usage for the affected billing window OR a usage-credit calculated as (observed lost token throughput / expected token throughput) * usage fees for the period. For negotiation, start with the percentage model (simpler) but leave the usage-credit as a fall-back if they push for precise token math.

Need Naomi to confirm if legal is comfortable with a short-term amendment rather than full contract redline. Also flagging that larger strategic accounts may expect an executive goodwill gesture — perhaps an additional one-time credit or extended monitoring at no charge for 30 days.

-Priyom
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

On Tue, Jun 28, 2028 at 11:03 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Wu <emily.wu@lumenbridge.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, naomi.feldman@redwood.ai, contracts@lumenbridge.com
Date: 2028-06-29T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed commercial remediation and amendment (LumenBridge)

Emily — following internal alignment, please find our proposed commercial remediation and next steps below. Attached is a draft contract amendment to capture the credit and monitoring commitment (draft-amendment-lumenbridge.docx) and a DocuSign link for convenience.

Our proposal:
1) Credit: one-time credit equal to 20% of LumenBridge's invoiced usage for the billing period that includes Jun 25-27. This is intended as a clear, simple remedy while we complete the technical post-mortem.
2) Monitoring & Fixes: 30-day complimentary advanced monitoring (no charge) across impacted routes, weekly status reports, and a dedicated engineering liaison.
3) Preventative changes: permanent adjustment to autoscaling thresholds for your pinned pools, kernel-selection regression tuning, and a scheduled performance review after 14 days of monitoring.

If agreeable, please sign the amendment here: https://docusign.com/templates/XYZ-12345 or let us know edits your legal team requests. We will issue the credit upon execution of the amendment and confirmation of the billing window. HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DEAL-7890

We want to be pragmatic — the 20% figure is our starting offer to expedite resolution. If you prefer the token-based usage calculation, we can run that as an alternative, but it takes longer to finalize.

Thanks — happy to hop on the call tomorrow at 10am PT.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
--- attachments: draft-amendment-lumenbridge.docx (DOCX)

From: Emily Wu <emily.wu@lumenbridge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@lumenbridge.com, support@lumenbridge.com
Date: 2028-07-02T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed commercial remediation and amendment (LumenBridge)

Karthik — thanks for the fast turnaround and the clarity.

LumenBridge is willing to accept the 20% one-time credit as an expedient path, provided we get:
- A signed amendment (our legal will review the DocuSign template)
- Confirmation that the 30-day monitoring will include access to the nightly reports and an engineering liaison for weekly calls
- A commitment that if the same class of failure reoccurs in the following 90 days, you will escalate to a senior exec liaison and offer an additional commercial remediation (to be negotiated in good faith).

Please proceed to send the DocuSign to contracts@lumenbridge.com and mark the amendment as "expedite review." Also confirm when the credit will post and whether it will appear as a bill credit or an invoice adjustment.

Emily Wu
Head of Platform Engineering
LumenBridge
